shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short; cat package.json; cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts; cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.interop.test.ts; cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.passthrough.test.ts; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; cat specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md'

/bin/zsh -lc 'cat node_modules/ajv/package.json | head -45; head -40 node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv.d.ts; cat tsconfig.json; cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.validation.test.ts; ls scripts/spec-links; git log -1 --oneline; cat jest.config.js'
/bin/zsh -lc "node --input-type=module -e \"import {Ajv} from 'ajv'; console.log(typeof Ajv)\"; npm ls ajv --depth=0; cat node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv.js | head -25; git status --short"
/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'node_modules/ajv\"|\"ajv\":|npm ci|npm install' package-lock.json .github/workflows/ci.yml; git show --stat -1; ls -a | rg 'npmrc|yarn' "
/bin/zsh -lc "git show HEAD~1:src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts | sed -n '1,125p'; git show HEAD~1:.lore/dod.md | head -10"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts'
s=open(p).read().replace(\"import {Ajv} from 'ajv';\\nimport type {ValidateFunction} from 'ajv';\", \"import AjvModule from 'ajv/dist/ajv.js';\\nimport type {Ajv as AjvClass, ValidateFunction} from 'ajv/dist/ajv.js';\")
s=s.replace(\"import {log} from '../../shared/logger.js';\", \"import {log} from '../../shared/logger.js';\\n\\nconst Ajv = AjvModule as unknown as typeof AjvClass;\")
s=s.replace(\"const details = errors.map(error => "'`${error.instancePath || '"'/'} "'${error.message ?? error.keyword}`).join('"'; ');\", \"const details = errors\\n        .map(error => {\\n          const missing = error.keyword === 'required' ? "'`/${String(error.params.missingProperty)}` : '"'';\\n          return "'`${error.instancePath}${missing || (error.instancePath ? '"'' : '/')} "'${error.message ?? error.keyword}`;'"\\n        })\\n        .join('; ');\")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/orchestration/tools/registry.interop.test.ts'
s=open(p).read().replace(\"    const execute = jest.fn(async () => 'ok');\", \"    let calls = 0;\\n    const execute = async () => {\\n      calls++;\\n      return 'ok';\\n    };\").replace(\"import {jest} from '@jest/globals';\\n\",'').replace('calls: execute.mock.calls.length,','calls,')
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='.lore/dod.md'
s=open(p).read().replace('## Out of scope','- [x] Include the missing property path in required-field rejections and repair CI-reported Ajv and lint failures.\\n\\n## Out of scope')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.unknown.test.ts --runInBand"

/bin/zsh -lc "mv src/orchestration/tools/registry.unknown.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.required-path.test.ts
python3 - <<'PY'
p='specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md'
s=open(p).read().replace('registry.unknown.test.ts#L4','registry.required-path.test.ts#L4').replace('registry.interop.test.ts#L5','registry.interop.test.ts#L4')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.interop.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.required-path.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --stat; git diff; nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.interop.test.ts | head -12; git status --short'

/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.interop.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.required-path.test.ts && git commit -m 'Fix validator interoperability and required paths' && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status -sb"
